verdict.rationale: The only premium processing evidence is the O-1A page, which lists a 15-business-day premium processing time against 4–6 months of standard USCIS processing and Alma's ~31-business-day preparation. That is a glancing mention, not an explanation of Form I-907 mechanics. Missing for 10: which classifications qualify for premium processing, the I-907 filing fee, what premium processing does and does not speed up (e.g., it does not shorten Alma's preparation time or later stages), and any dedicated explainer or independent corroboration.
